premise: Snail spends the whole day crossing the meadow to the pond — a grand expedition — and while Bird flies it in a blink and sees only grass, Snail arrives at sunset with the most to tell, and Bird asks to come along next time, slowly.
inspiration: The Tortoise and the Hare (Aesop), turned: not a race at all — the slow traveller sees the most, and the fast one wants to learn his way.
lesson: Going slowly lets you see what others miss.

en-US.title: Snail's Grand Expedition
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 16s} {sfx:meadow} One sunny morning, {snail:enter} Snail set off on a {snail:face happy} grand expedition: all the way across the meadow! {bird:enter} Bird swooped down. {bird:face happy} I can do that in a blink! {bird:go to pond} {sfx:whoosh} Whoosh, to the pond… {bird:go back} and whoosh, back again. {snail:live} Snail ducked into his shell. [curious] What did you see? {bird:face surprised} Um… grass? [slowly] So Snail went his own way. Slowly. Slowly. {snail:pulse} He saw a daisy with a sunny middle. He saw a dewdrop, round as a marble. He met {bee:enter} Bee, buzzing low over the clover, {bee:face happy} and she {bee:live} hummed him a tune so tiny that only a slow snail could hear it. {canvas:sunset 0.7 20s} As the sun went down, {snail:go to pond} Snail reached the pond at last. {bird:face happy} {bird:go to snail} Bird flew over. Well? What did you see? Snail told him everything. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] I didn't see any of that! [softly] Tomorrow, can I come too? Slowly? {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} Of course, said Snail. We'll start with the daisy.

es-ES.title: La gran expedición de Caracol
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 16s} {sfx:meadow} Una mañana de sol, {snail:enter} Caracol salió de {snail:face happy} expedición: ¡a cruzar el prado entero! {bird:enter} Pájaro bajó en picado. {bird:face happy} ¡Eso lo hago yo en un momento! {bird:go to pond} {sfx:whoosh} Fiuuu, hasta la charca… {bird:go back} y fiuuu, de vuelta. {snail:live} Caracol se metió en su concha. [curious] ¿Y qué has visto? {bird:face surprised} Eh… ¿hierba? [slowly] Así que Caracol siguió a su manera. Despacito. Despacito. {snail:pulse} Vio una margarita con el corazón de sol. Vio una gota de rocío, redonda como una canica. Y conoció a {bee:enter} Abeja, que zumbaba bajito entre el trébol, {bee:face happy} y que le {bee:live} tarareó una canción tan chiquitita que solo un caracol lento podía oírla. {canvas:sunset 0.7 20s} Cuando el sol se ponía, {snail:go to pond} Caracol llegó por fin a la charca. {bird:face happy} {bird:go to snail} Pájaro se acercó volando. ¿Y bien? ¿Qué has visto? Caracol se lo contó todo. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Yo no he visto nada de eso! [softly] ¿Mañana puedo ir contigo? ¿Despacito? {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} Claro, dijo Caracol. Empezaremos por la margarita.
